text:
maria: Hey — my docs PR (#4872) didn't auto-merge even though unit tests passed. Docs preview failed with a 504 on upload. It looks flaky. Who manages whether docs-preview is a required check for automerge? cc @sam

sam: Automerge is blocked by branch protection requiring the status check `docs-preview`. I can see the GH check failed with `upload-to-s3: 504`. automerge-bot left a blocking comment too.

automerge-bot: Automerge blocked: required status checks not passing: docs-preview

maria: Got it. Is there a minimal/temporary fix? We can't loosen protections org-wide. I just want this small typo fix to land — preview is clearly flaky for static assets.

lisa: Two options: 1) add a docs team reviewer (CODEOWNERS) so a human can approve + merge manually, or 2) make `docs-preview` optional in branch protection for this repo so automerge can proceed when other checks pass. I prefer 1 for safety.

jordan: Another pattern we've used: allow automerge to proceed only when PR has the label `docs:fast` AND all non-preview checks pass. That way we don't remove the check globally. automerge-bot can be configured to ignore `docs-preview` if the label is present.

sam: Implementing label-based exception is doable in the automerge config, but it's an extra rule to maintain. For immediate unblock, add a docs reviewer or retrigger the docs-preview job.

maria: I can ping the docs maintainers for a quick review. Also trying a rerun now. /retest-docs

ci-bot: docs-preview job retriggered by @maria — queued

automerge-bot: Note: automerge will re-evaluate once required checks are green. Current required checks: `[unit-tests, lint, docs-preview]`

lisa: I'll open a small PR to add CODEOWNERS entry so future tiny fixes don't stall. Example:```
/docs/ @redwood/docs-maintainers
```

jordan: And I'll sketch a tiny automerge rule for the repo:```
# automerge-config.yml
ignore_checks_when_label: "docs:fast"
required_checks: ["unit-tests","lint"]
```

maria: Perfect — for now I'm going to add the label and request @redwood/docs-maintainers as reviewer. Thanks everyone. :pray:
